description.zh:
分片集群实例中Shard节点ID或Mongos节点ID。

> 当实例类型为分片集群实例时，如不传入本参数，则重启分片集群实例。
description.en:
The ID of a shard or Mongos node in a sharded cluster instance.

> If you do not specify this parameter for a sharded cluster instance, the entire instance is restarted.

description.zh:
重启实例的时间点。取值：
- 0：立即切换。
- 1：在可运维时间段内切换。
description.en:
The time to restart the instance. Valid values:

- 0: The instance is restarted immediately.

- 1: The instance is restarted within the maintenance window.

descriptions.zh: 调用本接口可用于重启实例，也可用于重启分片集群实例中的某个Shard节点或Mongos节点。
descriptions.en: You can call this operation to restart an instance. You can also restart a shard or Mongos node in a sharded cluster instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds restart-db-instance --db-instance-id dds-bpxxxxxxxx --node-id d-bpxxxxxxxx --switch-mode 0 --node-type example-string --region cn-hangzhou
